label: GATHERINGS & BELONGING
相聚与连接
title: Leave some room for simply being together.
给单纯的相聚，留一点空间。
summary: Small summer gatherings in 2024 and 2025 offered a relaxed setting for conversation and time together.
2024与2025年的小型夏日聚会，为交流与相伴提供轻松的场景。
question: How can a community make space for informal connection?
社群如何为自然发生的交流，留出空间？
why: Alongside reading and structured discussions, Hotwind also made room for informal gatherings. The supplied photographs show people sharing a table, preparing the space and spending a summer evening together.
在阅读与主题讨论之外，热風也为轻松的相聚保留了空间。照片记录了大家布置现场、围桌交流、一起度过夏日夜晚的片段。

title: Create a welcome
准备相聚的空间
text: Welcome boards, a shared table and simple preparation gave the gathering a personal feel.
欢迎板、共享的餐桌与现场布置，让聚会带着大家共同准备的温度。

title: Make time to talk
留出交流的时间
text: A relaxed setting allowed conversations to continue beyond a formal programme.
轻松的场景，让交流可以延续到正式活动之外。

title: Keep a shared memory
留下共同的记忆
text: Photographs and event posters record the gatherings across two summers.
照片与活动海报，记录了两个夏天的相聚。

role: As founder and team lead, I helped sustain the community and its activities with the core team. These gatherings are shown as collective work.
作为创始人兼负责人，我与核心团队共同维系社群及活动；这里展示的是团队共同完成的相聚。
reflection: A community also grows through ordinary moments: preparing a space, sitting at the same table and having time for one another.
社群也在日常片段中生长：一起准备场地、围坐在同一张桌旁、把时间留给彼此。

label: FAMILY & OPEN DIALOGUE
家庭与开放对话
title: A place to talk about the words we grew up with.
聊聊那些，伴随我们长大的话语。
shortTitle: 原生家庭与打压式教育讨论
summary: An open salon invited reflection on discouraging education, family experience and personal growth.
通过开放沙龙，讨论打压式教育、家庭经历与个人成长。
question: How can personal experience become a thoughtful public conversation?
如何把个人经历，转化为认真而开放的讨论？
why: The original poster invited participants to discuss discouraging messages experienced while growing up. It brought a familiar personal topic into a shared space for reflection.
原始海报邀请参与者聊聊成长中经历的打压式教育，把熟悉而私人的议题，带入共同反思的空间。

title: Start from experience
从经历出发
text: The invitation centred on experiences of family and education.
以家庭与教育的真实经历作为讨论入口。

title: Open a conversation
打开讨论
text: An open-discussion format gave participants room to consider different perspectives.
通过开放讨论，为不同观点保留表达空间。

title: Reflect on growth
回到成长
text: The topic connected everyday language with questions about how young people grow.
把日常话语，连接到青年如何成长的问题。

role: I helped develop Hotwind’s programme of public discussions with the team. The original poster and supporting talk outline document this initiative.
我与团队共同推动热風的公共讨论活动，原始海报与讲演提纲记录了这次尝试。
reflection: Student-led discussion can offer space for expression and reflection. It should remain clear about the boundary between peer dialogue and professional psychological care.
学生主导的讨论可以提供表达与反思的空间，也需要明确朋辈对话与专业心理服务之间的边界。

label: LISTENING & PROGRAMME DESIGN
倾听与活动设计
title: Ask what people need before planning what comes next.
先听见需求，再设计下一步。
summary: Summer 2025 planning materials explored deeper social connection and multidimensional growth through questionnaire and interview design.
2025年夏季的调研设计材料，通过问卷与访谈构想，探索深度社交与多维度成长。
question: What would students want a community to help them explore?
学生希望一个社群，支持他们探索什么？
why: The planning brief asked whether campus activities supported meaningful connection and different kinds of personal growth. The aim was to let students’ needs inform future activities and the organisation’s structure.
调研提纲关注校园活动是否支持深度连接与不同维度的成长，希望从学生需求反向设计活动与组织运行框架。

title: Define the questions
明确问题
text: Identify two themes: meaningful social connection and multidimensional growth.
明确深度社交与多维度成长两个主题。

title: Explore ways to listen
设计倾听方式
text: Prepare questionnaire ideas and plans for conversations with students from different disciplines and years.
准备问卷构想，并规划与不同年级、不同专业学生的交流。

title: Inform future design
为后续设计提供依据
text: Use the questions to reconsider activities, participation and the community’s operating model.
用这些问题重新思考活动形式、参与方式与社群运行模式。

role: I helped frame the questions and connect the planning work to Hotwind’s development. The material is presented as exploratory planning rather than a completed research study.
我参与梳理问题，并把调研设计与热風的发展联系起来。这里呈现的是探索性规划，并非已完成的研究。
reflection: A useful question can change a programme. These materials do not establish an achieved sample size, validated scale or measured impact; draft literature-summary numbers are not reported as Hotwind’s findings.
一个好的问题，可能改变活动设计。这些材料不足以证明已完成的样本量、量表效度或实际影响；文献梳理草稿中的数字不作为热風的研究结果。
